name: pinned-header-sticky-footer
title: Pinned Header Sticky Footer
description: Viewport application framework with fixed header on top, central scroll area, and bottom action bar.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Pinned Header Footer Scroll: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
